bead.title: native claude transport: resolve + wire Anthropic credentials, fail fast if absent
bead.description:
PROBLEM: When FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT=native, newClaudeRunner (internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go:37) builds &claudeharness.Runner{NativeMode: claudeNativeTransportSelected()} but NEVER sets NativeAPIKey/NativeBaseURL (the claude Runner reads these at internal/harnesses/claude/native_runner.go:39-40 when building the provider). So the native path relies on an undocumented provider-registry env fallback to find an Anthropic API key; if none is reachable the failure is opaque and late (mid-turn), not at selection time.

ROOT CAUSE: execute_dispatch.go:37-38 constructs the native Runner without resolving credentials, and there is no fail-fast check when native is selected but no key is available.

PROPOSED FIX: In newClaudeRunner (internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go), when claudeNativeTransportSelected() is true, resolve the Anthropic API key (and optional base URL) from the SAME source the existing native Anthropic provider uses — grep internal/provider/anthropic for the canonical env var (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and reuse it; set Runner.NativeAPIKey/NativeBaseURL accordingly. If native is selected but no API key can be resolved, surface a clear early error (message naming the missing key, e.g. \"FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT=native but no Anthropic API key found; set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\") rather than proceeding. The default (subprocess) path must be byte-for-byte unchanged.

NON-SCOPE: do NOT add new config schema beyond reading the existing Anthropic key env/source. Do NOT flip the default transport. Do NOT change subprocess behavior.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test TestClaudeNativeCredentialWiring (internal/serviceimpl/execute_claude_transport_test.go): with FIZEAU_CLAUDE_TRANSPORT=native and the Anthropic key env set, newClaudeRunner returns a Runner with NativeMode=true AND NativeAPIKey populated.
2. New Test asserts native selection with NO Anthropic key produces a clear early error naming the missing key (not a nil-deref or late opaque failure).
3. Default (knob unset) still builds a subprocess Runner with NativeMode=false and empty NativeAPIKey (no behavior change) — existing TestClaudeTransportSelection still passes.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/serviceimpl/... ./internal/harnesses/claude/... -count=1 -timeout 150s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS on live-network tests).
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
